descriptions.value: Access of resource using incompatible type ('type confusion') in Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver (unionfs.sys) allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

descriptions.value: In multiple functions of cn_Tai.cpp, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write due to memory corruption. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In trusty_context_switch of services/spd/trusty/trusty.c, there is a possible Secure world register state leak due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to local information disclosure with execution privileges needed. User interaction is for exploitation.
